records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As of June 30, 2023, the Company had $0.9 billion unused capacity of its facility under the Programs.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Included in raw materials and supplies are work in process inventories which were not material as of June 30, 2023 and December 31, 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The decrease is primarily related to obligations to purchase lower quantities of agricultural commodity inventories.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Contract liabilities of $286 million and $694 million as of June 30, 2023 and December 31, 2022, respectively, were recorded in accrued expenses and other payables in the consolidated balance sheets.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Based on the Company’s historical ability to generate sufficient cash flows from its U.S. operations and unused and available U.S. credit capacity of $6.6 billion, the Company has asserted that these funds are indefinitely reinvested outside the U.S.
